additionalProperties.description_en: Entity attribute value. If the value is a complex type, it is represented as a JSON string
additionalProperties.description_zh: 实体属性值，如果为复杂类型，以JSON字符串表示

Attributes.description_en: Entity attributes. Complex values are represented as JSON strings
Attributes.description_zh: 实体属性，复杂值以JSON字符串表示
Attributes.title: 实体属性，复杂值以JSON字符串表示

CreateTime.description_en: Creation time as a millisecond-level timestamp
CreateTime.description_zh: 创建时间，毫秒级时间戳
CreateTime.title: 创建时间，毫秒级时间戳

additionalProperties.title: 自定义属性值的数组，当前仅支持单值数组

CustomAttributes.description_en: Custom attribute values. The key is the custom attribute identifier. The value is a list of attribute values
CustomAttributes.description_zh: 自定义属性值，key为自定义属性标识，value为属性值列表
CustomAttributes.title: 自定义属性值，key为自定义属性标识，value为属性值列表

MetaEntityDef.description_en:
Attribute definition of the custom entity.
<notice>For historical reasons, this property is not returned and its value is empty. We recommend that you use the GetMetaEntityDef API to obtain the entity type definition.></notice>
MetaEntityDef.description_zh:
自定义实体的属性定义
<notice>历史原因该属性不返回，值为空，建议通过GetMetaEntityDef API 获取实体类型定义</notice>
MetaEntityDef.title: 实体类型定义，仅内部查询场景返回

ModifyTime.description_en: Modification time as a millisecond-level timestamp
ModifyTime.description_zh: 修改时间，毫秒级时间戳
ModifyTime.title: 修改时间，毫秒级时间戳

OwnerId.description_en: Owner ID. The default value is the Alibaba Cloud UID of the creator
OwnerId.description_zh: 负责人ID，默认为创建者阿里云UID
OwnerId.title: 负责人ID

AllowedValues.description_en: Enumeration values. Required when Type is ENUM
AllowedValues.title: 枚举可选值，type=ENUM时必填

DisplayEnabled.description_en: Indicates whether the attribute appears on the product page. Default is true
DisplayEnabled.description_zh: 是否在详情页展示，默认为true
DisplayEnabled.title: 是否在页面展示，默认为true

DisplayName.description_en: Display name. It can be up to 32 characters long
DisplayName.title: 展示名称，最长32个字符

IsOptional.description_en: Indicates whether the value is optional. Default is true.><notice> Validation occurs when creating an entity. If this value is false and no value is provided during creation, validation fails and an error is returned.></notice>
IsOptional.description_zh:
取值是否可选，默认为true
<notice>在创建实体时会进行校验，如果该值为false，但创建时未提供，会校验失败报错</notice>
IsOptional.title: 是否可选，默认为true

Name.description_en: Attribute identifier. It can contain letters, digits, and underscores. It must start with a letter or digit and be up to 64 characters long
Name.description_zh: 属性标识，支持大小写字母、数字、下划线，必须以字母或数字开头，最长64个字符
Name.title: 属性标识，支持大小写字母、数字、下划线，必须以字母或数字开头，最长64个字符

SearchFilterEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the attribute can be used as a filter on the search page. Default is false.

Only attributes of type STRING, DATE, ENUM, ARRAY, INT, or BOOLEAN support this setting
SearchFilterEnabled.description_zh:
是否支持作为页面筛选条件（只影响搜索页面），默认为false；

仅 STRING、DATE、ENUM、ARRAY、INT、BOOLEAN 类型支持开启
SearchFilterEnabled.title: 是否支持作为筛选条件，默认为false；仅 STRING、DATE、ENUM、ARRAY、INT、BOOLEAN 支持开启

Type.description_en: Attribute type. Supported types include STRING, TEXT, INT, FLOAT, BOOLEAN, DATE, ARRAY, ENUM, and JSON
Type.title: 属性类型，支持 STRING、TEXT、INT、FLOAT、BOOLEAN、DATE、ARRAY、ENUM、JSON

MetaEntityDef.description_en: The definition of a custom entity

AttributeDefs.description_en: A list of entity attribute definition objects
AttributeDefs.description_zh: 实体属性定义对象列表
AttributeDefs.title: 属性定义列表

CreateTime.description_zh: 创建时间，毫秒级时间戳
CreateTime.title: 创建时间，毫秒级时间戳

EntityType.title: 实体类型；纯自定义为 custom_entity-{name}，扩展类型为 custom_{name}

Extend.description_en: The extension mode. Valid values: NONE and TABLE. NONE indicates a custom type. TABLE indicates that the type extends a table type
Extend.description_zh: 扩展模式，NONE表示纯自定义，TABLE表示扩展表类型
Extend.title: 扩展模式，NONE表示纯自定义，TABLE表示扩展表类型

ModifyTime.description_en: The time when the definition was last updated. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
ModifyTime.description_zh: 更新时间，毫秒级时间戳
ModifyTime.title: 更新时间，毫秒级时间戳

Name.description_en: The name of the type definition
Name.title: 类型定义名称；纯自定义类型示例 customer_api，扩展表类型示例 customer-table

MetaEntityDef.title: 自定义实体定义
